name: @pagestudiocms/pagestudio-template-development-server
description: This NodeJS command line tool sets up a development server on your computer, allowing PageStudio template developers to work on template code locally. It watches your template and recompiles when changes are made.
author: PageStudio Dev Team

scripts.build-watch-html: node bin/pagestudio.js compile --src example/html --out compiled --data-src example/html/data --partials example/html/partials --layouts example/html/layouts --watch
scripts.dev: node bin/pagestudio.js dev --src example/html --data-src example/html/data --partials example/html/partials --layouts example/html/layouts
scripts.start: node bin/pagestudio.js dev --src example/html --data-src example/html/data --partials example/html/partials --layouts example/html/layouts
scripts.compile: node bin/pagestudio.js compile --src example/html --out compiled --data-src example/html/data --partials example/html/partials --layouts example/html/layouts
